tasks.title: Restore doom.js script reference in web/index.html
tasks.instructions: In web/index.html the second script tag was changed to <script src="doom-missing.js"></script>, which does not exist in dist/doom/ and returns HTTP 404, so the Emscripten glue never loads and the game cannot start. Change that tag back to <script src="doom.js"></script> (build.sh emits build/doom.js and copies it to dist/doom/doom.js). Keep the relative path (no leading slash) so the static /doom/ subpath deployment works, and keep it after <script src="doom-boot.js"></script>, which defines the global Module before doom.js loads. Make no other edits: do not touch build.sh, platform/, web/doom-boot.js, or the DG_TEST_ exports.
tasks.acceptance: web/index.html references doom.js (no doom-missing.js anywhere under web/). After ./build.sh, dist/doom/index.html loads doom-boot.js then doom.js, both of which exist in dist/doom/ and are served with HTTP 200. The boot profile passes: the engine starts, the canvas is not blank, and the E1M1 player start is correct. The diff is a one-line change confined to web/index.html.

notes: Diagnosis: commit 18ab36d (test: inject browser startup regression) changed only web/index.html, replacing <script src="doom.js"> with <script src="doom-missing.js">. build.sh (emcc -o build/doom.js, which produces doom.js, doom.wasm and doom.data, then cp to dist/doom/) and web/doom-boot.js are unaffected. A single task is enough. The boot profile checks the build, LOAD-01 and WAD-01 directly. The controller's frozen final gate and independent review follow. The previous attempt's plan was rejected only because coder_role 'coder' is not allowed; coder_role is now web_frontend.
